title: North Quarry reading room closed until December 11 for roof work
summary: Holds pickup, returns and the community room stay open during the work.
body:
The roof over the North Quarry reading room is being replaced. A smaller collection is in the community room, and staff are at a desk by the front door.

The outdoor holds locker stays open 7 am to 10 pm.

title: Replacement library cards are now free once a year
summary: The library board removed the replacement card fee at its October meeting.
body: A first replacement each year is free at any desk. The board also voted to keep fines off for children's items.

title: The Library of Things adds telescopes and sewing machines
summary: Four telescopes and three sewing machines can now be borrowed with a card.
body: The telescopes were donated by the Ossel Ridge Astronomy Club (fictional). Each comes with a moon map and a red flashlight.

title: Lina Hargrove to speak at Central on Saturday
summary: The author of the November book club pick on researching her novel in the Ledger Room.
body: The talk is at 2 pm in the Kettle Room. No sign-up; 80 seats.

title: Bookmobile adds a Friday stop at Hartwell Commons
summary: Fridays 3 to 6 pm, starting this week.
body: Hartwell Commons was the most-requested new stop in this year's survey.

title: Ledger Room finishes scanning the 1950s
summary: Every issue of the Ledger from 1950 to 1959 is now searchable online.
